description: Fix broken ModelSelect popover and improve AI Settings page UX

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover for Headless UI v2
tasks.description: Remove the `<Transition>` wrapper around `<Popover.Panel>` in the ModelSelect component (lines 257-322 of AiSettingsSection.tsx). Replace with Popover.Panel using v2's native `transition` prop for enter/leave animation classes. Remove the unused `Transition` and `Fragment` imports if no longer needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Popover.Panel renders to DOM when clicking Mohist Model selector button
Popover.Panel renders to DOM when clicking Coder Model selector button
Popover.Panel renders to DOM when clicking any Stage Model Override selector
Model list is visible and searchable after popover opens
Selecting a model closes the popover and updates the displayed value
tasks.notes: Root cause: Transition in Headless UI v2 does not auto-detect Popover open state. The v2 Popover.Panel supports transition classes natively via its `transition` prop.

tasks.title: Reorder AI Settings layout and add provider grouping
tasks.description: Reorder the AiSettingsSection JSX so Model Selection appears first. Split the flat provider list into two groups: Connected Providers (always open) and Available Providers (collapsed by default with count badge). Add a `useState` toggle for the Available Providers section. Show empty-state guidance when no providers are connected.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection section is the first interactive section on the page
Connected providers appear in an always-open section after Model Selection
Unconfigured providers appear in a collapsed section titled 'Available Providers (N)'
Clicking 'Available Providers' header toggles the section open/closed
Section is not shown when there are no unconfigured providers
Connected section shows guidance text when no providers are configured
tasks.notes: Reuse the existing useState pattern (like stageOverridesOpen) for the available providers toggle. Layout order: Model Selection → Connected Providers → Available Providers → Custom Providers → Stage Model Overrides.
